newsitem.title: USA: CSX, Norfolk Southern set pact to split Conrail.
newsitem.headline: CSX, Norfolk Southern set pact to split Conrail.

text.p: CSX Corp. and Norfolk Southern Corp. Tuesday unveiled highly anticipated details of their proposed $10.3 billion acquisition of Conrail Inc. that call for both railroads to receive split key routes of the Philadelphia-based carrier.
Under the plan, Norfolk Southern will pay $5.9 billion for 58 percent of Conrail and CSX will pay $4.3 billion for 42 percent of the East Coast railroad.
